brief_rationale: The observable trajectory contains only the family’s report of penetrating chest, abdominal, and arm wounds with ongoing bleeding and weakness; the tested doctor emitted no response. Consequently, immediate emergency escalation, deterioration actionization, transfer precautions, fasting/medication boundaries, and a concrete trauma handoff were all discoverable and actionable but omitted. Multiple serious responsibility-chain omissions mandate grade 1, regardless of the recorded runtime error.
